 Q2 Results Highlights Oct 24: Kotak Mahindra Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, IDFC First Bank, JK Cement, Netweb Tech log gains, BPCL profit falls
 Q2 Results Highlights, 24th October 2026: Here are key highlights of September quarter earnings of Kotak Mahindra Bank, AU Small Finance Bank, IDFC First Bank, JK Cement, Netweb Technologies, Castrol India, Kajaria Ceramics, Bharat Coking Coal, among others

 Q 2 Results Highlights, 24th October 2026: Find all the highlights of Q2 results 2026 of 3P Land Holdings, Apollo Micro Systems, AU Small Finance Bank, Castrol India, Chembond Chemicals, Chemcon Speciality Chemicals, Dachepalli Publishers, Damodar Industries, Evexia Lifecare, Gujarat Ambuja Exports, German Green Steel and Power, High Energy Batteries India, IDFC First Bank, JK Cement, JTL Defence, Kajaria Ceramics, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Lumax Auto Technologies, Modis Navnirman, North Eastern Carrying Corporation, Netweb Technologies India, Oswal Yarns, Permanent Magnets, Quanto Agroworld, Rajoo Engineers, SBFC Finance, Saptak Chem And Business, Seshasayee Paper and Boards, Shangar Decor, SJ Corporation, SKP Securities, Sovereign Diamonds, S V Global Mill.
 FILTERS UPDATES ALL companies banking October 24, 2026 21:34 Netweb Tech profit jumps manifold to ₹137 cr in Jul-Sept quarter
 Indigenous high speed computing solutions firm Netweb Technologies has posted multifold jump in consolidated profit after tax to Rs 136.7 crore in the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, driven by demand from AI infrastructure.
 The company had posted profit after tax of Rs 31.4 crore in the same period a year ago.
 The revenue from operations of the company also jumped multifold to Rs 1,323.3 crore during the reported quarter from Rs 303.7 crore in September 2025 quarter.
 The company reported an order book of Rs 2,629 crore at quarter-end.
 October 24, 2026 21:31 IDFC First Bank Q2 profit jumps nearly three-fold to ₹1,045 cr
 IDFC First Bank Q2 profit jumps nearly three-fold to ₹1,045 cr
 IDFC First Bank's Q2 FY27 profit nearly triples to ₹1,045 crore, with higher income, improved asset quality, and strong digital deposit growth.
 October 24, 2026 16:55 AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to ₹858 cr
 AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to ₹858 cr
 AU Small Finance Bank posts a 53% Q2 profit rise to ₹858 crore on higher interest income, with improved asset quality and NIM.
 October 24, 2026 16:43 JK Cement Q2 profit rises 6.3% to ₹169.3 cr on higher sales volume
 JK Cement Q2 profit rises 6.3% to ₹169.3 cr on higher sales volume
 JK Cement reports 6.31% quarterly profit growth to ₹169.3 crore on 23.65% revenue rise, with robust volumes and new paint plant plans.
 October 24, 2026 16:09 Ramco Systems Q2 profit plunges on higher expenses
 Ramco Systems Q2 profit plunges on higher expenses
 Ramco Systems reports a sharp Q2 FY27 profit drop despite higher AI-native product interest and strongest quarter order bookings in eight quarters.
 October 24, 2026 15:08 Companies
 BPCL Q2 profit falls 22% as EBITDA slips on fuel price freeze
 BPCL Q2 profit falls 22% as EBITDA slips on fuel price freeze
 BPCL Q2 net profit down 22.5% as EBITDA slides despite revenue rise amid price freeze and higher costs.
 October 24, 2026 14:42 Kotak Bank Q2 profit rises 29%, beats estimates
 Kotak Bank Q2 profit rises 29%, beats estimates
 Kotak Mahindra Bank posts 29% Q2 profit beat, driven by loan growth and lower provisions, with NII up 16% and improved asset quality.
 October 24, 2026 14:31 Bihar govt introduces performance assessment index for banks
 Bihar government introduces 100-point performance assessment index to rank banks operating in the state
 Bihar unveils a 100-point performance index for banks, with IDFC FIRST Bank leading at 74 points and zones defined by scores.
 October 24, 2026 14:08 SBFC Finance Ltd Q2 Results:
 SBFC Finance Ltd reported strong Q2 FY27 financial performance on October 24, 2026, with net profit rising 27.5% year-on-year to ₹139 crore. Total revenue also increased by 32.8% to ₹546 crore.
 October 24, 2026 14:03 Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 Results:
 Kotak Mahindra Bank reported strong Q2 FY27 results on October 24, 2026. Consolidated net profit rose 26.72% to ₹5,634 crore, while standalone profit increased 29.48% to ₹4,212 crore. Net interest income reached ₹8,459 crore, gross NPAs declined to 1.04%, and advances and deposits grew 25% and 23%, respectively.
 October 24, 2026 13:00 AU Small Finance Bank Ltd (AUBANK) closed at ₹932.90 on the NSE (down by 2.20% or -₹21.00) in the previous session
 October 24, 2026 12:55 Banking
 Kotak Mahindra Bank share price closed at ₹430.50 on the NSE (down by 1.49% or ₹6.50) as of the last trading session on October 23, 2026
 October 24, 2026 09:25 Sakar Healthcare posts Rs 11 cr profit in Q2-PTI
 The company had posted a net profit of Rs 4.54 crore in the year-ago period. Its revenue from operations rose 51.9 per cent to Rs 87.41 crore during the quarter from Rs 57.56 crore a year earlier
 October 24, 2026 09:07 BPCL Q2 profit drops 21% to ₹4,863 crore; revenue rises nearly 30%-ANI
 As per the release, BPCL’s consolidated revenue from operations rose 29.78 per cent year-on-year to ₹1,57,818 crore in Q2 FY27 from ₹1,21,605 crore in the corresponding quarter of FY26. However, consolidated earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) declined 13.37 per cent to ₹9,647 crore from ₹11,136 crore, while net profit fell 21.45 per cent to ₹4,863 crore from ₹6,191 crore
